name: Can I connect any gas grill to a natural gas line?

mainEntity.name: Can I connect any gas grill to a natural gas line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not all gas grills are compatible with natural gas lines. Grills are typically designed for either natural gas or propane, and the orifices and regulators differ between the two. A propane grill cannot be directly connected to a natural gas line without a conversion kit specifically designed for that model. Attempting to connect an incompatible grill is a significant safety hazard. CG Plumbing Solutions can help assess your grill's compatibility and advise on safe connection or conversion options.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, not all gas grills are compatible with natural gas; propane grills require specific conversion kits for safe connection.
